content.short: SolidityScan is an automated smart contract vulnerability detector.
content.description: SolidityScan is an automated smart contract vulnerability detector by Credshields. It lets developers scan their contracts for vulnerabilities, fix the issues, and publish audit reports with a single click. With more than 3,500 users and support for 131 vulnerability patterns, SolidityScan positions itself as a leading tool for quickly identifying risks and producing auditable results in today’s market. The solution helps teams accelerate secure deployment and communicate risk clearly to stakeholders.
